items.headline: RBI anticipated to hike interest rates amidst rising inflation and crude prices
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is expected to consider interest rate hikes in its October and December monetary policy meetings. S&P forecasts a 25 basis point hike in the current fiscal year, projecting consumer inflation to average 5.1%. Elara Securities anticipates 25-50 bps rate hikes in 2026 due to inflation, crude prices, rupee pressure, and narrowing interest rate differential with the US.

items.headline: India's CPI inflation projected to average 5.1%, Nomura anticipates breach of 6%
items.summary: S&P projects India's CPI inflation to average 5.1% for the current fiscal year. Nomura anticipates that India's inflation will breach the 6% mark in the coming months.

items.headline: Government reforms and sustained capital expenditure support Indian equities
items.summary: Ongoing government policies such as GST 2.0 and consistent capital expenditure are cited as supportive macroeconomic fundamentals for the Indian equity markets.

items.headline: Indian markets influenced by mixed global cues; US bond yields and geopolitical tensions weigh on sentiment
items.summary: Indian equity markets opened largely flat amidst mixed global cues. Elevated US 10-year Treasury yields, which climbed to around 5.22%, continued to restrain risk appetite. Investors are also closely monitoring developments regarding the US-Iran conflict and global bond selloff.

items.headline: Crude oil prices ease slightly on US-Iran negotiations; gold continues decline
items.summary: Brent crude eased to around $99/bbl from above $100, and WTI Crude Oil traded at $93.12 per barrel, down 1.59%, following reports of US and Iranian negotiators exploring a phased route to end the war. Gold prices extended their decline towards $4,280/oz due to a stronger dollar and higher Treasury yields.

items.headline: ESDS Software Solution reports 14% YOY profit increase, 7.3% revenue growth
items.summary: ESDS Software Solution reported a 14% year-on-year increase in consolidated profit to ₹29.3 crore for the quarter, with revenue rising 7.3% to ₹133.7 crore.

items.headline: Purple Style Labs narrows consolidated loss, revenue up 13%
items.summary: Purple Style Labs reported a narrower consolidated loss of ₹88.1 crore, against ₹100.3 crore a year earlier, with revenue increasing 13% to ₹119.4 crore.

items.headline: Q2 FY27 earnings season for IT and banking majors to kick off in October
items.summary: The second quarter FY27 earnings season is scheduled to commence in October, with major IT companies including TCS, Infosys, HCLTech, and banks like HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, ICICI Bank set to report their results.

items.headline: IT sector shows mixed performance; Nifty IT declines while BSE IT gains, Realty sector rises most
items.summary: The BSE IT sector emerged as the top gainer with a robust 3.71% increase, however, the Nifty IT index was among the biggest laggards, falling 1.44%. The Nifty Realty sector recorded the highest gains. Auto, financial services, banking, and metal indices also showed signs of recovery during the day.

items.headline: Wheels India launches QIP with floor price of ₹2,197.10 per share
items.summary: Wheels India opened its Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) on September 24, setting a floor price of ₹2,197.10 per share.

items.headline: Inox Green Energy Services launches QIP at ₹174.36 per share floor price
items.summary: Inox Green Energy Services also launched its Qualified Institutions Placement (QIP) on September 24, with a floor price of ₹174.36 per share.

items.headline: Dr Lal PathLabs to acquire 70% stake in SN Genelab for up to ₹168 crore
items.summary: Dr Lal PathLabs' board approved the purchase of a 70% stake in SN Genelab for a maximum of ₹168 crore, with the transaction expected to close by November 30, 2026.

items.headline: Waaree Energies' subsidiary enters specialty gases market, approves amalgamation, secures 2 GW solar module contract
items.summary: Waaree Clean Energy Solutions, a subsidiary of Waaree Energies, has entered the specialty gases market for semiconductors. The board also approved the amalgamation of its subsidiary Indosolar at a 1:11 share exchange ratio and secured a contract to supply 2 GW of solar modules.

items.headline: Transport Corporation of India board to consider share buyback on September 29
items.summary: The board of Transport Corporation of India is scheduled to meet on September 29 to consider a proposal for the buyback of its equity shares.

items.headline: Lemon Tree Hotels' subsidiary acquires land in Mumbai for ₹120 crore to build new hotel
items.summary: Fleur Hotels, a subsidiary of Lemon Tree Hotels, acquired land in Bandra (East), Mumbai for ₹120 crore for the development of a new hotel project.

items.headline: Nykaa inks investment deal with L'Oréal's BOLD fund
items.summary: Nykaa has signed an investment deal with L'Oréal's BOLD fund, aimed at investing in high-growth Indian beauty and personal care brands.

items.headline: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited, Noble Polymers announce dividends
items.summary: Sri Lotus Developers and Realty Limited announced a dividend of ₹0.50 per share with an ex-date of September 25, 2026. Noble Polymers also has an ex-dividend date of September 25, 2026.

items.headline: PB Fintech shares fall 36% on IRDAI commission changes proposal
items.summary: Shares of PB Fintech (Policybazaar) dropped 36% following proposed changes by IRDAI regarding insurance distribution commissions, which the company indicated could significantly impact revenue from its general insurance business.

items.headline: Sedemac Mechatronics sees 11.05% stake offloaded in block deal
items.summary: A block deal took place on Thursday where five entities, including Nandan Nilekani's NRJN Family Trust, offloaded an 11.05% stake in Sedemac Mechatronics for ₹1,468.83 crore.

items.headline: Hero Motors, Aeroflex Neu, EKI Energy Services among top gainers
items.summary: Hero Motors, Aeroflex Neu, and EKI Energy Services were noted as top gainers. Other top gainers on NSE during market recovery included Adani Enterprises, Power Grid, Shriram Finance, Asian Paints, SBIN, Axis Bank, Nestle, LT, Bajaj Auto, JSW Steel, Indi Go, Adani Ports, Trent, and HDFC Life.

items.headline: Waaree Energies, Wheels India, Godrej Industries, Piramal Finance in focus
items.summary: Waaree Energies, Wheels India, Godrej Industries, and Piramal Finance are expected to be in focus due to recent corporate announcements.

items.headline: Privi Speciality Chemicals, Bajel Projects highlighted as Indian growth stocks
items.summary: Privi Speciality Chemicals and Bajel Projects were highlighted as Indian growth stocks to watch.
